chip.description: Gate-array custom (Fujitsu-fabricated ULA) on Nichibutsu mahjong hardware: input multiplexing, coin handling, sound-ROM banking and NMI clock generation in one part.
chip.notes: Identification from MAME src/mame/nichibutsu/nb1413m3.cpp ('the NB1413M3 is a Fujitsu ULA'). TB5: I/O, banking and timing duties with no dominant branch on a board-specific ASIC, so custom.
